title: University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA)
summary: University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA) is a university in Huntsville. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with UA.

sections.heading: What UA is known for
paragraphs: The University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant undergraduate enrollment of 6,591 students. UA maintains an admission rate of approximately 68.57%, reflecting a moderately selective admissions process. The university is recognized for its strong emphasis on business programs, which constitute about 20.46% of its academic offerings. Additionally, health-related programs represent nearly 9.7% of the curriculum, highlighting UA's commitment to preparing students for careers in healthcare. These program distributions illustrate the university's focus on fields that align with regional and national workforce demands.

sections.heading: How to read UA tuition
paragraphs: The University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA) provides distinct tuition rates for in-state and out-of-state students. In-state tuition is set at $12,132, reflecting the reduced cost for residents of Alabama. Out-of-state students are charged a higher tuition fee of $26,408. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition, fees, and other expenses, amounts to $27,392. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending UA.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: The University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA) offers financial aid options to support students in managing educational expenses. Approximately 24.64% of UA students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies aimed at assisting low-income students. Among those who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $20,705. Prospective students can explore estimated costs and financial aid opportunities through UA's official net price calculator available at www.uah.edu/, as well as the College Scorecard website at https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/school/?100706.

paragraphs: The University of Alabama in Huntsville (UA) has a student body composed of approximately 60.95% men and 39.05% women, reflecting a gender distribution with a male majority.
